description.value:
Frequency once per encounter

Requirement You are 11th level or higher and have landed at least three Strikes, Hot Loaded at least once, or taken Gun Failure at least once this encounter.

Fire your Finisher. Make a ranged Strike with a +2 circumstance bonus that deals three additional damage dice and cannot be reduced below one die of damage by any resistance. On a critical hit the target is also stunned 1. Afterward the weapon is emptied and you cannot use this again until the encounter ends.

cinderfall.incomplete: none of the three alternative trigger conditions (landed Strikes / Hot Loaded / took Gun Failure, tallied across the whole encounter) has a roll-option/counter mechanism to track it without a companion resource, and it's a Strike-granting Finisher action regardless. This card's entire effect is a limited-use activated action/reaction that hands the actor a wholly new usable action -- per this pass's fixed bucket-3 convention this is always INCOMPLETE regardless of precedent. Ironsight's own real-world analog, the Gunslinger, ships this exact shape unencoded across dozens of its own Strike-variant/reload-trick/called-shot feats (e.g. pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feats/class/gunslinger/level-10/called-shot.json, level-6/scatter-blast.json, level-1/dual-weapon-reload.json, all rules: []) -- confirming this is the standard shape for a gunfighter class, not license to SKIP. This effect is defined entirely in terms of a Cinderfall-homebrew subsystem with zero Foundry schema footprint (the Gun Failure Table/Failure Range, hazardous ground, time-in-sights, Trick Iron charge bank, or Drift/augment-slot cost). Confirmed via the full rule-element type listing (pf2e-source/src/module/rules/rule-element/, 40 files): no RollTable-manipulation, no persistent-terrain-hazard, and no arbitrary stacking-counter rule element type exists to hook any of these to.
